body: Quick pass (M5) at ec697404. The PR merges with main. The author's quick gate is green, and no golden moves. The body has Fixes #1620, a Changelog line and the parts that were not exercised. #1620 is P3 and is not paused. The PR is ready for review by M3.

Fix for review 5903951172 (item 1). New head: 8deec2acd6bf3469c2ad499527a362930c0e9db9.

## The fix
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/ring.rs`: the new constant `BOUNDARY_TOL` (1e-9 mm). `on_boundary` uses it. It is the one tolerance for the two tests.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chord_clear.rs`: the new function `vertex_touch`. Before the edge loop, each loop vertex within `BOUNDARY_TOL` mm of the chord line splits the chord. The test measures a distance, not the edge parameter. This is the change from your review.

## New tests (in `chord_clear.rs`)
- `a_chord_end_a_hair_off_the_wall_line_still_splits_at_a_short_chamfer`: your probe. The second piece has a 0.014 mm chamfer. The chord goes from (-8, -32) to (32, -32 - d), with d = 0, 1e-12, 1e-10, 5e-10, 9e-10 and -5e-10. Each chord must not clear.
- `a_vertex_touches_the_chord_within_the_boundary_tolerance_and_not_beyond`: on a 40 mm chord and a 0.01 mm chord, on the two sides of the line. A vertex 0.9 x `BOUNDARY_TOL` off the line splits the chord. A vertex 1.1 x `BOUNDARY_TOL` off the line does not split it. A chord end and a vertex past the end do not split the chord.

## Mutation result
- With the vertex split removed (the logic of head ec697404), the chamfer test fails: "end 1e-10 mm off the line: the gap x in (-8, 8) is outside".
- With the tolerance at 2 x `BOUNDARY_TOL`, the tolerance test fails at 1.1 x ("does not touch").
- With the tolerance at 0.5 x `BOUNDARY_TOL`, the tolerance test fails at 0.9 x ("touches").

## Results (macOS, debug)
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green. Motion suites 141 s, app suites 236 s, 0 failed. This includes `golden_cl` and `solid_law_goldens`. No golden moved.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-fail-fast` (all 80 motion test binaries): 942 passed, 0 failed, 52 ignored.
- `adaptive_pinch` with `--include-ignored` (the disc pin and the Milling-test pin): 2 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

I did not do the non-blocking note 1 (a pin for the crossing side of `EPS`). I did not file note 2 (a "part outside stock" message).

The decision file `docs/decisions/1620-chord-pieces.md` now records the change. The PR stays a draft.

M3, please do a re-review of head 8deec2ac.

**Delta review @ 8deec2ac** (since ec697404): **clean**, `merge-ready`.

- The requested change is done.
  - `vertex_touch` splits the chord at each loop vertex within `BOUNDARY_TOL` mm of the chord line. It measures this as a distance, not as an edge parameter.
  - `BOUNDARY_TOL` is one constant in `ring.rs`, and `on_boundary` uses the same constant.
- The chamfer probe is now a unit test. It refuses the chord for each offset d in {0, 1e-12, 1e-10, 5e-10, 9e-10, -5e-10}.
- A two-sided pin checks the tolerance: 0.9 × `BOUNDARY_TOL` splits and 1.1 × does not, on a long chord and on a short chord.
- Mutation, run again here: without the `vertex_touch` loop, the chamfer probe fails. With the loop restored, all 5 `chord_clear` unit tests pass.
- The author reports a green quick gate and 942 passed in the 80 motion binaries. No golden moved.

Post-merge PathPilot Hub check on the 770MX simulator (PathPilot v2.14.4), 2026-11-14 22:35-22:41 local, file `hub-tests/1651-adaptive-link/pr.nc` (PR head 8deec2ac), T6 6 mm end mill, length 2.0 in. It ran to M30 with no alarm: cycle time 00:04:59 (feed override 200%), last line 1269. The tester: "looks pretty good". In the preview the adaptive passes and their links stay in the pocket area around the part. No move goes through the part. One move worried the tester: at the start the tool went down, back up, then across. That is the tool-change block (`G53 G0 Z0`, `G30`, `T6 M6`, `G43 H6`, `G53 G0 Z0`). The simulator's stored G30 is below machine Z0, so G30 moves down to it and the next `G53 G0 Z0` goes back up. It is not from this PR. The fix in the simulator: jog Z to the top and press SETG30 (as for #1594).
